name: @planb/shared
comments: Source-only. This package is NEVER installed or built — web/ resolves it through a Vite
alias and mobile/ through Metro watchFolders, so each app compiles the TypeScript itself.
That is why there are no `dependencies` and no build script: nothing to hoist means no root
package.json and no workspace tooling (root CLAUDE.md §2).
Anything listed under peerDependencies must already be installed by the consuming app, at the
same version in both — zod especially, or the two apps end up with incompatible ZodType identities.
